messages:
sam_csm: Heads-up: AstralNet tokens are down ~74% since the ML lead left last Thursday. procurement has spun up a 2-week trial with FluxServe. marking as renewal-risk and opening triage. :warning:
maria_sales: Oof. who replaced the lead? do we know if this is a full migration or just testing?
lee_cs: I'll take outreach. suggest a two-pronged approach: (1) immediate 20m reconnect + quick enablement for the new contact, (2) short report showing cost/throughput comparisons + remediation checklist. can we pull their prompt footprint? :mag:
rahul_eng: Checking infra now. no server errors in the past 45d but I see lots of 401s around SSO callbacks for that org. could be they haven't completed SSO setup after the handover. running a query:
rahul_eng: ```sql
-- recent auth failures by day
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, count(*) as failures
FROM auth_events
WHERE account_id = 'astralnet' AND event = 'sso_callback'
AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC;
```
infra_bot: Usage snapshot: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/astralnet/overview (14d: -74% tokens, seats 15->5). Top countries: US, UK. :bar_chart:
sam_csm: Thanks Rahul + bot. Maria, commercial posture? any concessions already offered?
maria_sales: procurement asked about Dedicated and a private tenancy; FluxServe pitch highlights cheaper throughput and an on-prem connector. we haven't offered credits yet. contact in CRM: Helena M. (new ML lead listed as Omar P.).
lee_cs: Proposed next steps: 1) immediate email + calendar propose (24-48h) from CS + sales for a 20m enablement; 2) send a short diagnostics snippet to run and request their top 5 production prompts; 3) offer a 10k promo credit applied to first month of Dedicated canary if they commit to an enablement + exec sync.
rahul_eng: To help enablement, I'll prepare a small packet: latency heatmap, model variants used, and a CSV of top request paths. also recommend they run this local diagnostic to confirm SSO and workflow status:
lee_cs: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/astralnet/diagnostic \
  -d '{"check_sso":true, "sample_days":7}'
```
infra_bot: Note: QBR/exec sync slot free Fri 14:00-14:30 via /calendar book. :calendar:
sam_csm: If SSO is the culprit, enablement + a configuration run should restore large part of automated workflows. Lee, please ask them to confirm any disabled cron jobs or runbooks. we'll prioritize recovering automation flows.
maria_sales: I'll tentatively approve the promo credit contingent on a verbal commit from Helena + a rough scope for the Dedicated canary. legal prefers credits over price changes.
lee_cs: Reaching out to Helena + Omar now. tagging @maria_sales for the credit condition. also requesting their prompt examples and any fine-tunes.
rahul_eng: FYI I also see a spike in requests from a different IP range that stopped after last Tuesday 1st. could be they paused background batch jobs. no model-level regressions on our side.
sam_csm: Good diagnostic. action owner summary:
- lee_cs: outbound to customer + run diagnostic request
- rahul_eng: produce usage + auth CSV and a short tech appendix for enablement
- maria_sales: standby for promo credit after verbal commit
- sam_csm: draft one-pager: quick wins, rollback plan, and how FluxServe differences compare
lee_cs: emailed Helena; proposed Wed/Thu 20m slots and asked for prompt samples. will update thread. :email:
infra_bot: Reminder: flag set to renewal-risk (auto) and tickler set for 72h follow-up. :clock3:
lee_cs: update 2h later: Helena replied, prefers Wed 11:00. asked for a short note on SSO steps and Dedicated canary terms. added Omar to the convo.
sam_csm: Great. Rahul, can you prepare the SSO checklist + a short script they can run to validate callbacks?
rahul_eng: On it, will paste the checklist and a simple auth test script before the meeting.
lee_cs: meeting booked Wed 11:00. goal: enablement + verbal on credits, then Dedicated pilot kickoff if all good. we'll reassess renewal risk after pilot starts. :rocket:
